name: ai/__init__.py
summary: Package-level initialization that re-exports AIQueryService to provide a clean public interface for the AI service module.
purpose: Simplifies the import contract for consumers by exposing AIQueryService at the package boundary, insulating downstream modules from internal file organization changes within the ai service package.
responsibilities: Re-export AIQueryService from the ai_query_service submodule
Define the public API surface of the ai services package
Shield consumers from internal module restructuring
outputs: AIQueryService exposed at the ai package namespace
architecture_notes: Implements the Python package facade pattern by centralizing the public API in __init__.py. This reduces import path complexity for dependent services and enforces a stable contract boundary, allowing internal implementation modules to be refactored without impacting importers. It acts as a lightweight service locator mechanism within the backend's AI domain.
improvements: Add __all__ = ['AIQueryService'] to explicitly declare the public API and prevent namespace pollution
Add a module docstring describing the AI service package's role and usage
Consider lazy imports if the package scales to avoid heavy initialization at import time
Re-export related types, exceptions, or constants alongside AIQueryService if the package grows
